name: select
summary: A labelled list of choices of which one is chosen, opened from a button that shows the choice.

properties.name: label
properties.description: What the choice is for, shown above it and its spoken name.

properties.name: hideLabel
properties.description: Hides the label's words; the select keeps it as its name.

properties.name: value
properties.description: The value of the chosen option; none until one is chosen.

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: Shown in the button while nothing is chosen. It is never the name.

properties.name: description
properties.description: Supporting words under the label, read after the name.

properties.name: error
properties.description: What is wrong; the button's edge turns destructive.

properties.name: required
properties.description: A choice is required; the label gets a marker and the name says required.

slots.name: options
slots.description: The choices, each a value and the words that name it.

events.name: press
events.description: The button is pressed and the list opens.

states.name: rest
states.description: An edge at 3:1 on the page, the chosen words or the placeholder, and a chevron.

states.name: pressed
states.description: The button takes the accent fill while pressed; it never scales.

states.name: focused
states.description: The ring colour, twice as thick.

accessibility.name: Its label, with required when it is; its value, the chosen words or none; then its error and description.
accessibility.keyboard: One tab stop for the button; Space, Enter or Down opens the list, arrows move through it, Enter chooses and Escape closes it and returns focus to the button.
accessibility.web: A <div> trigger with role="combobox", aria-haspopup="listbox", aria-expanded and aria-labelledby the label, whose list is a role="listbox" of role="option" elements with aria-selected; aria-describedby for the description and error. The cases say button only because a case's agent role has no combobox.
accessibility.apple: A Menu or Picker named by its label (", required"), its value the chosen words, its hint the error then the description.
accessibility.windows: UI Automation ControlType.ComboBox with the ExpandCollapse and Value patterns, named by its label, help text its error then its description; the list items are ControlType.ListItem with SelectionItem.
accessibility.android: Role.DropdownList with an expand action, named by its label (", required"), its state description the chosen words, its error then its description after it; the options are menu items with the selected state.

cases.person: A Course label with a red marker and a button that says "Choose a course" with a chevron.
A button that says "Main" with a red edge and the error under it.

deviations: multiple, option groups, readOnly, name and form for forms, and a bottom sheet for the list on a phone.
The list opens as a flyout over the button on every device; there is no bottom sheet on Windows.
No multiple or option groups yet.
The list opens as a dropdown menu from the button, as Material's exposed dropdown does, not as a bottom sheet.
No multiple or option groups yet.
